items.title: One sidebar for every window
items.text: The sidebar's all-windows list is shared across windows, so reordering, folding and renaming in one window shows up in all of them.

items.title: Drag to reorder
items.text: Drag windows and project groups into the order you want, and drag a window into a group or back out of one.

items.title: Rename in place
items.text: Rename windows, groups and panes right from their sidebar rows.

items.title: + buttons
items.text: Start a new window, a new window inside a project group, or a new pane split the way you last split by hand, straight from the sidebar.

items.title: Clearer rows
items.text: Window rows get a window icon, this window's list sits under its own header with + and ×, and a grouped window's Panes list shows its group.

items.title: Smoother drags
items.text: Rows no longer vanish or stay lit mid-drag, drops land cleanly, and background windows don't redraw while you drag.

items.title: New windows open maximized
items.text: New windows fill the screen by default.
